title: Stale transformers<5 constraint blocks vllm 0.24.0 bootstrap requiring transformers>=5.6.0
error_summary: Fromager bootstrap fails: transformers>=5.6.0 (from vllm 0.24.0) is irreconcilable with constraint transformers<5 in rhaiis cpu-ubi9 constraints
suggested_resolution_summary: Remove or update the transformers<5 constraint in collections/rhaiis/cpu-ubi9/constraints.txt to allow transformers>=5.6.0
confidence_justification: The error message directly names the conflicting specifier (transformers>=5.6.0) and constraint (transformers<5). The constraint file comment (AIPCC-9443) documents the original intent. The merge commit AIPCC-27609 updated vllm from 0.21.0 to 0.24.0 without updating the constraint. Both aarch64 and x86_64 jobs fail identically with the same error at the same resolution step. The earlier successful resolution of transformers>=4.38.0 (from xgrammar) to 4.57.6 confirms the constraint is active and the conflict is specifically with the vllm-originated specifier.
target_repo_reason: The fix requires updating collections/rhaiis/cpu-ubi9/constraints.txt in the pipeline repository, where the stale transformers<5 constraint is defined.

references.description: Contains the transformers<5 constraint with AIPCC-9443 comment explaining its original purpose — confirmed this is the source of the blocking constraint
Shows vllm==0.24.0+rhaiv.1 as the pinned version — confirmed the vllm version that introduced the incompatible transformers>=5.6.0 requirement
Maps to torch-2.11.0 constraints — verified that torch-level constraints do not include a transformers constraint
Checked for transformers constraints at the torch collection level — none found, confirming the constraint is only in the pipeline repo
Checked for global transformers constraints — only sentence-transformers<5.2.1 found, not transformers
Reviewed vllm build settings for dependency overrides — no transformers-related overrides found

tools.name: git log/diff on rhai-pipeline
tools.description: Used git log and diff on the pipeline repo clone to trace the AIPCC-27609 merge commit that updated vllm from 0.21.0 to 0.24.0 without updating constraints — confirmed the constraint-requirement mismatch was introduced by this specific commit
